defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 11)
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, a painted ram has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once a painted ram is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 23.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ramming Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The painted ram Strides up to two times, then makes a horn Strike with Improved Knockdown.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sticky Paint
offensiveAbilities.description: A painted ram's Strikes splatter paint on the target. On a critical hit, this paint swiftly dries, and the target becomes Clumsy 1 for 10 minutes. As an Interact action, the target or an adjacent creature can remove enough paint to end the condition.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
